statusLine.command: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "Set-Variable status ([Console]::In.ReadToEnd()|ConvertFrom-Json);Set-Variable aic ([decimal]((Get-Variable status -ValueOnly).ai_used.total_nano_aiu)/1000000000);[string]::Format([Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo('en-US'),'AIC {0:N2} ({2}{1:N2})',(Get-Variable aic -ValueOnly),((Get-Variable aic -ValueOnly)/100),[char]36)"
